 With clean lines and classic proportions, every function and feature was considered.Mova is designed to keep up with the pace of your work. It’s your very own personal assistant. We have transformed the idea of a salon staple storage into a personal mobile work assistant that moves and works with you. 
 With Personal Power & USB, mova is a unique trolley that allows you to operate your electrical tools from the back of trolley. With only one electrical cord plugged into the wall that controls the power, multiple tools can be used (behind the chair) and no longer at the wall. 
 Designed by Comfortel,  mova showcases our love for materials. We wanted it to be a show stopper, so we designed it with sleek finishes, hard metals and easy to clean surfaces to make it easier for you to define style with pride.

Created by Comfortel.

it’s your personal workspace 
 Styling made simple with more workspace 

Expand mova’s side drawers to create a workspace that’s larger than life. Easily hang your towel, store your hair tools or simply lay out your tint bowls and foils with more room to move. 
 It’s sleek for the minimalist 

A lesson in chic simplicity, there are no handles on the drawers to spoil those clean lines; just a lip that’s easy to slide open. The curved frame is wrapped with aluminium and contrasts with the heat proof inserts. 
 It has style with substance 

Not only is mova a good looking piece, but it’s highly functional too. Set on wheels, it’s easy to move around a space, while the pull open drawers create more storage.

discover the features

 Personal Power & USB

 Everything about the Ivy Waiting Sofa says ‘inviting’. The curved shape. The plump cushion. Even the plush textured sage green upholstery. Designed by our in-house design team,  we wanted to create a compact sofa and that’s makes a statement. 
 This compact piece, seating 2-3 people comfortably, proves that good things do come in small packages. The textured green upholstery guarantees resilience, akin to the hardy ivy plant it’s named after. And with its sturdy black metal legs, Ivy II stands firm, no matter the season. 
 Embrace the green. Revel in comfort. With Ivy II, we invite you to sit back, relax, and let nature take its course. It’s more than just a seat – it’s a natural wonder!

Curves and Comfort Combined 
 Sage Green Textured Upholstery :

Adorned in our signature sage green upholstery, Ivy II brings a piece of nature’s tranquility into your salon. 
 Curvaceous and Chubby Design

 The Ivy II Sofa features a curvaceous and chunky design, providing a striking aesthetic appeal while creating an inviting and comfortable seating experience. 
 Seating Capacity

 Designed to seat 2-3 people comfortably, Ivy II fosters a cozy, inclusive atmosphere. 
 Sturdy Black Metal Legs

 Robust black metal legs ensure that Ivy II is as durable and stable as it is stylish. 
 Compact but Powerful

 Though compact in size, Ivy II is big on impact. It’s a testament that grandeur can indeed come in small packages. 
 Versatility

 With its blend of aesthetics and functionality, Ivy II is an ideal addition to hair salons, beauty salons, or any space needing an inviting waiting area. 
 Designed for Salons

 Designed by our talented in-house team, Ivy II encapsulates thoughtfully chosen design elements for a truly unique seating solution. 
 Remember, with Ivy II, you’re adding more than a sofa to your salon, you’re integrating an experience that’s curvy, comfortable, and irresistibly chic!

This is mova .  Made for you, with help by you. 

 
 With clean lines and classic proportions, every function and feature was considered.Mova is designed to keep up with the pace of your work. It’s your very own personal assistant. We have transformed the idea of a salon staple storage into a personal mobile work assistant that moves and works with you. 
 With Personal Power & USB, mova is a unique trolley that allows you to operate your electrical tools from the back of trolley. With only one electrical cord plugged into the wall that controls the power, multiple tools can be used (behind the chair) and no longer at the wall. 
 Designed by Comfortel,  mova showcases our love for materials. We wanted it to be a show stopper, so we designed it with sleek finishes, hard metals and easy to clean surfaces to make it easier for you to define style with pride. 
 Designed for salons. Developed with hairdressers.

Created by Comfortel.

it’s your personal workspace 
 Styling made simple with more workspace 

Expand mova’s side drawers to create a workspace that’s larger than life. Easily hang your towel, store your hair tools or simply lay out your tint bowls and foils with more room to move. 
 It’s sleek for the minimalist 

A lesson in chic simplicity, there are no handles on the drawers to spoil those clean lines; just a lip that’s easy to slide open. The curved frame is wrapped with aluminium and contrasts with the heat proof inserts. 
 It has style with substance 

Not only is mova a good looking piece, but it’s highly functional too. Set on wheels, it’s easy to move around a space, while the pull open drawers create more storage.

discover the features 
 We have looked at every detail that a hairdresser needs…and wants. 
 Personal Power & USB 

The unique trolley that allows you to operate your electrical tools from the back of trolley. With only one electrical cord plugged into the wall that controls the power, multiple tools can be used (behind the chair) and no longer at the wall. 
 It’s got generous storage 

Perfect for storing all your hair tools, mova boasts four roomy drawers and an expandable workspace that easily fits your hairdryer, straightener and tint bowls. Hang your towels on the side too. 
 So smooth and strong 

With a rounded steel frame, and tapered furniture inspired legs, mova is strong and sturdy while proving the salon staple trolley can be a designer statement piece. 
 Heat proof mats and easy wheel hubless castors 

We considered all your must haves, so we created removable heat proof mats tailored to fit your hair tools and easy to clean. The designer look hubless castors makes it easy to move around the salon.

for the eco conscious… 
 Ok, get ready…cause, we are excited!  Meet an environmentally friendly salon chair, ready to make a difference in your salon.

Nicknamed ‘Eco’ this salon chair is made from reclaimed wood chips and recycled plastic.

Cool. I know! 
 We wanted to create a salon chair exploring how a sustainable composite material could be used to create an affordable, comfortable salon seat. 
 And so, meet Eco..

‘eco’ salon chair’s difference… 
 It is made using a mixture that is 85% of recycled or post waste plastic and 15% per cent wood chips. The wood chips all come from reclaimed wood, while recycled plastic is favoured over so-called “virgin” plastic found in most plastic style salon chairs. 
 Eco has a rounded bowl-shaped seat, and is super compact in size, making it comfortable to sit on thanks to the rounded shape of the backrest.  The light speckled surface, showing the wood chips, gives a natural look to your salon space.  Perfect for salons wanting a lighter look to their salon chair. 
 And here’s the best bit….did we mention that it’s stain free* , check out how it performs with even the darkest of hair colour .  The smooth surface and the clean lines of the design makes the chair easy to wipe clean.
